setting: Rain-soaked neon alley in futuristic Bangkok at night, wet pavement, drifting steam, glowing Thai signs and connected rooftop lines.
action: Create three separate cinematic versions from the same courier topic: one restrained and tense, one dynamic and urgent, and one quiet and reflective.

reference_image_notes: @Image1 is the primary face and identity reference. @Image2 is a second character reference for coat silhouette and distinctive wardrobe details. @Image3 should guide alley composition, wet reflections, and neon atmosphere.

avoid: flicker, extra limbs, deformed hands, chaotic background warping, messy object motion
additional_notes: Keep the result premium and believable, like alternate teaser concepts from the same streaming-series world. Each prompt should stand alone as an option the user can choose later.
